an11.12:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Sakkesu viharati Kapilavatthusmiṃ Nigrodhārāme.
an11.12:1.2: Tena kho pana samayena Mahānāmo Sakko gilānā vuṭṭhito hoti aciravuṭṭhito gelaññā.
an11.12:1.3: Tena kho pana samayena sambahulā bhikkhū Bhagavato cīvarakammaṃ karonti
an11.12:2.4: Atha kho Mahānāmo Sakko yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho Mahānāmo Sakko Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:--
an11.12:2.6: sambahulā kira bhikkhū Bhagavato cīvarakammaṃ karonti
an11.12:2.8: Tesaṃ no bhante nānāvihārehi viharataṃ ken' assa vihārena vihātabban' ti? 2.
an11.12:3.2: etaṃ kho Mahānāma tumhākaṃ patirūpaṃ kulaputtānaṃ, yaṃ tumhe Tathāgataṃ upasaṅkamitvā puccheyyātha
an11.12:3.3: ‘tesaṃ no bhante nānāvihārehi viharataṃ ken' assa vihārena vihātabban' ti.
an11.12:3.4: Saddho kho Mahānāma ārādhako hoti no asaddho,
an11.12:3.9: Imesu kho tvaṃ Mahānāma pañcasu dhammesu patiṭṭhāya cha dhamme uttariṃ bhāveyyāsi. 3.
an11.12:4.2: ‘iti pi so Bhagavā . . . pe . . . Satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho Bhagavā' ti.
an11.12:4.3: Yasmiṃ Mahānāma samaye ariyasāvako Tathāgataṃ anussarati, nev' assa tasmiṃ samaye rāgapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti, na dosapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti, na mohapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti,
an11.12:4.4: ujugatam ev' assa tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ hoti Tathāgataṃ ārabbha,
an11.12:4.5: ujugatacitto kho pana Mahānāma ariyasāvako labhati atthavedaṃ, labhati dhammavedaṃ, labhati dhammūpasaṃhitaṃ pāmujjaṃ,
an11.12:4.6: pamuditassa pīti jāyati, pītimanassa kāyo passambhati, passaddhakāyo sukhaṃ vediyati, sukhino cittaṃ samādhiyati.
an11.12:4.7: Imaṃ kho tvaṃ Mahānāma buddhānussatiṃ gacchanto pi bhāveyyāsi, ṭhito pi bhāveyyāsi, nisinno pi bhāveyyāsi, sayāno pi bhāveyyāsi, kammantaṃ adhiṭṭhahanto pi bhāveyyāsi, puttasambādhasayanaṃ ajjhāvasanto pi bhāveyyāsi. 4.
an11.12:5.1: Puna ca paraṃ tvaṃ Mahānāma dhammaṃ anussareyyāsi . . . pe . . .
an11.12:5.7: yathārūpāya saddhāya samannāgatā tā devatā ito cutā tattha upapannā, mayham pi tathārūpā saddhā saṃvijjati;
an11.12:5.11: paññāya samannāgatā tā devatā ito cutā tattha upapannā, mayham pi tathārūpā paññā saṃvijjatī' ti.
an11.12:5.12: Yasmiṃ Mahānāma samaye ariyasāvako attano ca tāsañ ca devatānaṃ saddhañ ca sīlañ ca sutañ ca cāgañ ca paññañ ca anussarati, nev' assa tasmiṃ samaye rāgapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti, na dosapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti, na mohapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti,
an11.12:5.13: ujugatam ev' assa tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ hoti devatā ārabbha,
an11.12:5.14: ujugatacitto kho pana Mahānāma ariyasāvako labhati atthavedaṃ, labhati dhammavedaṃ, labhati dhammūpasaṃhitaṃ pāmujjaṃ,
an11.12:5.15: pamuditassa pīti jāyati, pītimanassa kāyo passambhati, passaddhakāyo sukhaṃ vediyati, sukhino cittaṃ samādhiyati.
an11.12:5.16: Imaṃ kho tvaṃ Mahānāma devatānussatiṃ gacchanto pi bhāveyyāsi, ṭhito pi bhāveyyāsi, nisinno pi bhāveyyāsi, sayāno pi bhāveyyāsi, kammantaṃ adhiṭṭhahanto pi bhāveyyāsi, puttasambādhasayanaṃ ajjhāvasanto pi bhāveyyāsī
